ex: Can you give me a simple use case for this app?
The main use case is booking tables at restaurants.
We need to write a use case before we start coding.
This tool has one clear use case: saving time.
I love games with a big open world.
In an open world, you can go anywhere you want.
Is the open world in this game fun to explore?
The open world has forests, cities, and mountains.
open world.note: Often used before a noun: "an open-world game."

ex: She saved a set point and won the game.
He has a set point, and the crowd is quiet.
They lost the first set after missing three set points.
It is set point, so the next ball is very important.
set point.note: In tennis and volleyball. In science, "set point" also means a target level, like a temperature.

ex: The theater has an open call for young actors.
Is the open call for artists still open this week?
We sent our photos to an open call for a festival.
The museum announced an open call for new projects.
The writer is giving a public talk at the library.
Can anyone come to the public talk on Friday?
The public talk is free, but you need a ticket.
After the public talk, people asked a lot of questions.
She won the game on her first match point.
It is match point, and everyone is standing up.
He saved two match points and won the final.
On match point, she hit the ball into the net.
Journalists can work in the media center during the games.
Where is the media center for the conference?
Our school media center has computers and lots of books.
The media center opens at eight in the morning.
media center.note: In US schools, a "media center" is often the library.

ex: She wants to study data science at the university.
Data science helps companies understand their customers.
Is there a good online course in data science?
He got a job in data science last year.
The minister will speak at the press club tomorrow.
Journalists often meet at the press club after work.
Is the press club open to the public?
The press club organized a meeting about free media.
She posted a room tour of her new apartment.
Can you make a room tour video for us?
I like watching room tours to get ideas for decorating.
In this room tour, he shows his small bedroom.
I have my performance review with my manager on Monday.
We get a performance review once a year.
Did your performance review go well?
After a good performance review, she asked for a raise.
The community manager answers questions from users online.
Our company is looking for a new community manager.
Can I talk to the community manager about this problem?
As a community manager, she works with fans every day.
The media manager posts news on the team's website.
Our media manager talks to journalists every day.
Please send your questions to our media manager.
He works as a media manager for a small theater.
media manager.note: Also "social media manager." The word also names software for photos and videos.

ex: The art manager plans all the gallery's shows.
She works as an art manager at a city museum.
Can I speak to the art manager about the exhibition?
Our art manager found new artists for the festival.
art manager.note: Also "arts manager." In video games, the art manager leads the artists.

ex: The press officer answered questions from the journalists.
Please contact our press officer for more information.
The police press officer gave a short statement.
She works as a press officer for the city hospital.
press officer.note: In the US, people also say "spokesperson" or "press secretary."

ex: In a smart city, buses use apps and sensors.
Our town wants to become a smart city.
Smart city projects can help save energy and time.
What makes a smart city different from a normal city?
She worked as a model for fashion magazines.
The model posed for photos in the park.
He wants to become a fashion model one day.
The models are getting ready for the photo shoot.
photo model.note: In English, usually just "model" or "fashion model."

ex: The band will hold a fan meeting in Kyiv.
We bought tickets for the fan meeting last week.
At the fan meeting, the singers played games with fans.
Is the fan meeting before or after the concert?
fan meeting.note: Used mostly about K-pop stars; also "fan meet."

ex: I need a better work-life balance this year.
This company cares about work-life balance.
How do you keep a good work-life balance?
Working from home helped my work-life balance a lot.
We are learning a cover dance to our favorite song.
Her cover dance video got thousands of views.
Can we film our cover dance in the park?
The school club does a cover dance every month.
cover dance.note: Used mostly about K-pop: fans copy the dance from a music video.

ex: I bought the battle pass to get new skins.
Is the battle pass worth the money this season?
The new battle pass starts next week.
You get rewards when you level up your battle pass.
She wants to find a job in high tech.
Many young people work in high tech in this city.
The country is spending more money on high tech.
Is it hard to start a career in high tech?
high tech.note: Usually an adjective: "a high-tech phone." As a noun, "tech" is more common.

cash and carry.gram: a cash and carry · cash and carries
ex: We buy drinks for the café at a cash and carry.
Is there a cash and carry near the restaurant?
Small shops often get their goods from a cash and carry.
The cash and carry sells food in very large packs.
cash and carry.note: Mostly British. In the US, people usually say "warehouse store."

ex: Can you show me how to do a cat eye?
She wears a cat eye with red lipstick.
A cat eye looks great for an evening party.
I need a thin brush for a perfect cat eye.
cat eye.note: Often before a noun: "cat-eye makeup," "cat-eye glasses."

ex: Our company uses content marketing to find new customers.
She writes blog posts as part of our content marketing.
Is content marketing better than paid ads?
He took an online course in content marketing.
I get a beauty box with new products every month.
Is this beauty box a good gift for my sister?
The beauty box has a cream, a mask, and lipstick.
She opens her beauty box in a video every month.
Two soldiers were hurt by friendly fire.
The army said the deaths were caused by friendly fire.
In this game, friendly fire can hurt your teammates.
Can I turn off friendly fire in the game settings?
friendly fire.note: Means shooting at your own side by mistake.

ex: Slow fashion means buying fewer clothes of better quality.
She only buys from slow fashion brands now.
Is slow fashion more expensive than fast fashion?
This local shop sells slow fashion made by hand.
The museum has art objects from many countries.
Please don't touch the art objects in this room.
This old chair is now an art object.
They put a large art object in the city park.
The party is black tie, so I need a suit.
Do I have to wear black tie to the dinner?
The invitation says black tie, so wear a tuxedo.
Men wore black tie, and women wore long dresses.
black tie.note: A dress code: "The dinner is black tie." It also means a black bow tie.

ex: My brother works as a data engineer at a bank.
We are hiring a data engineer for our new project.
What does a data engineer do every day?
The data engineer built a new system for our reports.
We can play this game in split screen.
Use split screen to open two apps at once.
How do I turn on split screen on my phone?
The news showed both reporters on a split screen.
The sound engineer checked the microphones before the concert.
Can the sound engineer make the music a bit louder?
He works as a sound engineer in a music studio.
We need a sound engineer for our podcast.
Please send a press kit to the journalists.
Our press kit has photos, videos, and a short bio.
Where can I download the band's press kit?
The company made a new press kit for the launch.
Let's go out for hot pot tonight.
With hot pot, you cook meat at the table.
Is the hot pot at this restaurant very spicy?
We ordered a big hot pot for four people.
hot pot.note: In British English, "hotpot" can also mean a meat and potato stew.

ex: Both candidates are visiting the swing states this week.
The election will be decided in a few swing states.
Is this state a swing state or not?
Polls in the swing states are very close.
swing state.note: A US state where either main party can win the election.

ex: My father goes fly fishing every summer.
Fly fishing is popular on mountain rivers.
Can you teach me the basics of fly fishing?
You need a special rod for fly fishing.
My old headphones have a mini jack.
Does this laptop have a mini jack for headphones?
I need a cable with a mini jack at each end.
Many new phones don't have a mini jack anymore.
mini jack.note: Usually called a "headphone jack" in everyday English.

ex: She offers life coaching to people who want to change jobs.
Life coaching helped me set clear goals.
How much does one hour of life coaching cost?
He started a business in life coaching last year.
Our website runs on a fast web server.
The web server is down, so the site won't open.
Can you restart the web server, please?
We need a new web server for more users.
We went to a drag show at a small club.
The drag show starts at nine on Saturday.
Are tickets for the drag show still available?
The performers wore bright costumes in the drag show.
This site is a useful web resource for English learners.
The teacher gave us a list of web resources.
Can you suggest a good web resource about cooking?
Our library has many free web resources for students.
web resource.note: In everyday English, people often say "website" or "online resource."

ex: The famous runner is a brand ambassador for sports shoes.
She works as a brand ambassador for a coffee company.
How do you become a brand ambassador?
Our brand ambassadors post photos of our products online.
The dress code at our office is business casual.
Is business casual okay for the job interview?
For business casual, wear nice pants and a shirt.
On Fridays, most people come to work in business casual.
The head chef plans the menu every week.
Can I talk to the head chef about my allergy?
She became head chef at a small Italian restaurant.
The head chef tells the other cooks what to do.
I do power yoga three times a week.
Power yoga is faster and harder than normal yoga.
Is there a power yoga class this evening?
After power yoga, I feel strong and tired.
She does face yoga every morning in front of a mirror.
Can face yoga really help with wrinkles?
Face yoga uses exercises for the muscles of the face.
I watched a short video about face yoga.
Please send a bug report if the app crashes.
I wrote a bug report about the broken button.
Where can I find the form for a bug report?
The team fixes the bug reports from users every week.
She works as a content maker for a travel blog.
Our company needs a content maker for social media.
Many young content makers film videos on their phones.
Is it hard to earn money as a content maker?
content maker.note: "Content creator" is much more common in English.

ex: Hot yoga is done in a very warm room.
Bring a big towel and water to hot yoga.
Is hot yoga safe if you have heart problems?
I tried hot yoga for the first time today.
She wore a silk slip dress to the party.
Do you have this slip dress in a smaller size?
A slip dress looks great with a jacket in fall.
I bought a black slip dress for summer evenings.
I'm getting my nails done at the nail bar.
Is there a nail bar in this shopping mall?
The new nail bar near my office is very busy.
She works at a nail bar on weekends.
nail bar.note: Mostly British. In the US, people usually say "nail salon."

ex: The dress code for the dinner is smart casual.
Is smart casual okay for an office party?
For smart casual, wear nice jeans and a shirt.
Most guests came to the event in smart casual.
smart casual.note: Common in British English. In the US, "business casual" is more usual.

ex: He made a tier list of his favorite pizzas.
Can you make a tier list of these games?
In my tier list, this movie is in the top tier.
Let's watch the new tier list video together.
She sings lead vocals in a rock band.
Who sings lead vocal on this song?
He played guitar and sang lead vocals at the concert.
The drummer also sang lead vocals on two songs.
lead vocal.note: Usually plural: "She sings lead vocals." The person is the "lead singer."

ex: This island has some of the best dive sites.
How deep is the water at this dive site?
The boat takes divers to the dive site every morning.
We saw turtles and colorful fish at the dive site.
The city wants to become an IT hub.
Many startups have offices in the new IT hub.
Is this city a big IT hub in Europe?
The old factory is now a modern IT hub.
IT hub.note: "Tech hub" is more common in English.

ex: The business trainer taught us how to sell better.
Our company invited a business trainer for a two-day course.
She works as a business trainer for small companies.
Can a business trainer help us improve our meetings?
business trainer.note: "Corporate trainer" or "business coach" is more common in English.

ex: You can change the settings through the web interface.
Log in to the web interface with your password.
Does this router have a simple web interface?
The new web interface is easier to use on a phone.
These jeans come in a slim fit and a regular fit.
Do you have this shirt in a slim fit?
A slim fit looks good on tall people.
I prefer a slim fit for suits.
